scenes.title: Schlom Oxide MBE Apparatus Bay
scenes.reference_notes: The inspected official photograph supports paired tall stainless process chambers, multiple bolted ports, lower source sticks, cable bundles, open steel support frames and a right-hand load-lock/transfer assembly. The legacy full-room tour is unavailable. This reconstruction therefore covers an estimated apparatus bay, not a recovered Cornell room perimeter. Geometry and control strokes are original estimates; no OEM CAD or validated interlocks are included.
observed_cues: Paired cylindrical vessels with dense bolted flanges and upper service stalks.
Open metal frames, low source feedthroughs and cable looms.
Smaller transfer/loading assembly to the right of the growth vessels.
scenes.reconstruction_scope: Local apparatus bay; room perimeter, access door and service coordinates are authored.

params.authored_pose: Floor-mounted frames and electronics chassis; room perimeter is not source measured.

support.evidence: Authored leveling feet, steel legs and crossmembers rest on z=0.

equipment.role: Paired oxide growth chambers, load-lock hatch and clamped substrate-transfer rod

layout_evidence.supports: Two tall vessels, surrounding framework, multiple ports and right-hand transfer region; no room measurements.

layout_rationale: Keep the cylindrical multi-chamber footprint as the room focal point, with a front operator aisle and rear service zone.
Use independent four-post frames with grounded feet; the right-hand transfer station is a lower supported assembly.
Do not infer Cornell room dimensions from the isolated apparatus photograph; all room boundaries and the side desk are authored context.

circulation.operator_approach: Front aisle; estimated unobstructed approach from left entry.
circulation.service_access: Rear service strip is visual context; no building-code clearance certification.

task.name: Inspect and position an MBE substrate carrier
task.description: Exercise the load-lock hatch and transfer holder, and observe substrate and door-handle poses. These are geometry and access operations only.
task.observable: Measured load_lock_door and transfer_rod joint states and clamped substrate site.

limitations: Room size, placement and mechanism strokes are authored estimates; no surveyed or institution-approved floor plan.
No vacuum, thermal control, film deposition, RHEED or scientific measurement process is implemented.
Independent joint tests are mechanical checks, not an actual safe vacuum-system operating sequence.
Source images are external references; no original photographs, logos or OEM CAD are embedded.
The model is an original research reconstruction with no institutional endorsement or verified source-media redistribution permission.

scenes.title: SHRIMP Ion Microprobe Instrument Room
scenes.reference_notes: Inspected the official SHRIMP RG facility preview. Its long white cabinet base, curved vacuum/analyzer region, tall right-side source assembly, numerous flanges, cable looms, overhead ventilation boxes and green wall stripe inform the model. The 360 interface and room perimeter have not been measured. Magnet/source interiors and load-lock controls are authored surrogates, not a surveyed instrument twin.
observed_cues: Large contiguous white cabinet chassis with controls and vented access panels.
Curved vacuum/analyzer hardware and a tall stainless source assembly on the right.
Multiple flange ports, thin cable bundles, corrugated hoses and overhead service boxes.
scenes.reconstruction_scope: Instrument-room preview reconstruction; cabinet scale, beamline geometry and room boundaries estimated.

params.authored_pose: Grounded white modular cabinet chassis; source exterior and analyzer are static. Mechanism strokes are representative.

support.evidence: Ten rectangular leveling feet and stems beneath a full-width instrument cabinet.

equipment.role: Room-scale ion microprobe exterior with load-lock, mineral-mount translation and rotation

layout_evidence.supports: Room-scale white instrument cabinet, curved analyzer region, tall vacuum source, cables, overhead air boxes and green wall stripe.

layout_rationale: A broad instrument chassis occupies the room center rather than a generic tabletop vacuum box.
Keep an operator aisle across the front and a side control desk; their exact distances are authored estimates.
The instrument model preserves the dominant large analyzer and tall source silhouette; no claim is made about measured field-sector angles or internal beam trajectories.

circulation.operator_approach: Clear estimated front approach from left entry.
circulation.service_access: Authored rear zone; actual maintenance access and building code compliance remain unverified.

limitations: Room and instrument dimensions are estimated from a preview, not a measured 360 reconstruction or OEM drawing.
No charged-particle optics, magnetic field, vacuum, detection physics, isotopic ratios or geological-age calculation is implemented.
Independent access/translation/rotation controls serve geometry review and do not implement actual SHRIMP operational interlocks.
Original institution media, trademarks and OEM CAD are not distributed in the modeled geometry; no endorsement is implied.

task.name: Position an ion-microprobe mineral mount
task.description: Inspect the load-lock, translate its clamped carrier and rotate the mount while reading measured joint states. Scientific analysis is outside this task.
task.observable: Measured load_lock_door, sample_transfer and sample_rotation states and mineral_mount site.
